# Min Value

> Minimum [half-precision floating-point number][half-precision-floating-point-format].

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var FLOAT16_MIN = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/min' );
```

#### FLOAT16_MIN

Minimum [half-precision floating-point number][half-precision-floating-point-format].

```javascript
var bool = (FLOAT16_MIN === 6.103515625e-05 );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->
